notes.title: My deepest heartfelt apologies..
notes.content:
Yesterday it came to my attention that Dere-chan was in fact using the wrong bust size for the Dere-chat game. Despite staying up till 2am to correct the issue I fear that the damage has been done.. too many people have already been subjected to the incorrectly proportioned Dere-chan and for this I am so sorry..

Okay but seriously this was just a minor fix for something I've somehow missed for a while as well as a few basic text gramma/formatting fixes. 

Flat is Justice, Medium is Premium, Oppai is truth

notes.title: Last update for a little while.
notes.content:
Things are looking pretty good with Dere-chat for the moment so I'll be moving back to working on Wifu-Box for a little while. Do let me know if there is anything you'd like to see added to the game or if you spot any other bugs I've missed! 

this update includes:

Click text while it's still going finishes it instead of skipping to the next dialogue.
Back button is working (it wont be available if a player or wifu has made a decision) 
Added a "Factory reset" to the title settings page. 

Thank you again everyone who has joined us for this wild-ride. It has truly been an amazing experience releasing my first solo-game on steam and I hope you're as excited for the future of Wifu-Box as I am! 
Keep on keeping on! ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: Ironing out the launch bugs (1.2)
notes.content:
So far as launches go Dere-chat has been shockingly smooth.. Still there were a few minor bugs that have been fixed in this update. Thanks again to everyone who reported bugs over on our discord, you have been a huge help 💖

Things this update fixes:

 Startup sound too high (I'm embarrassed how long this took me T^T)
End-cutscene dialogue button freezes end-cutscene.
Fix hotbar icon (was Unity default)
Removed dev dialogue helper (numbers in bottom right of text box)
Some minor spelling errors
Wifu button doesn't appear when Fox  skin unlocks


As for what's up next it's of course the linux build for the loveable penguins out there looking for some chill time with Dere-chan 🐧💖 

Also thinking a "reset factory settings" button might be a good idea.. Though the moral implications of just "resetting" a true sentient artificial intelligence are.. maybe I'll need to add a little something to the bot arc for that..🤖💔
